description.value: This animal study investigated the effects of 25 days of Tuina therapy on pain behavior and resting-state ALFF in a chronic compression of the dorsal root ganglion neuropathic pain model in male rats.

spans.text: In this study, we used resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (R-fMRI) to explore the analgesic mechanism of Tuina in an NP rat model.

description.value: Randomized animal experiment with three parallel groups: sham operation, CCD surgery without Tuina, and CCD surgery followed by daily Tuina intervention. Behavioral testing was performed longitudinally, and resting-state fMRI was acquired at baseline and 7 and 28 days after surgery.

description.value: Mechanical nociception test measuring the force eliciting paw withdrawal using an electric von Frey aesthesiometer.

spans.text: The electric von Frey aesthesiometer (ALMEMO 2450, IITC/Life Science, Woodland Hills, CA, United States) was utilized to conduct measurement of MWT at intervals exceeding 1 min ( Yao et al., 2022 ).

Paw withdrawal thermal latency (PWL) and mechanical withdrawal threshold (MWT) are the commonly used methods to test mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in experimental animals ( Yao et al., 2022 ).
